data.description: Elevation allows elements to be lifted from the background. It can be defined by applying drop shadows or other visual cues, such as color and borders

shadows.description: Elevation using shadows reflects a spatial relationship by indicating separation from the background or allowing content to be scrolled under another element.

levels.name: Message Container Shadow
levels.description: 50% black opacity with viewport-relative blur (~0.8vw). Used for floating toast/message notifications.

levels.name: Header Shadow
levels.description: Solid dark shadow (0.5vw blur) matching header background for seamless sticky header effect.

levels.name: Search Field Shadow
levels.description: Dark shadow for search field overlay to separate from background content.

levels.name: Search Field Shadow Mobile
levels.description: Directional shadow for mobile search field with vertical offset.

levels.name: Button Inset Shadow
levels.description: Subtle inset shadow at bottom of buttons for depth effect, 50% black opacity.

levels.name: Product Image Focus Shadow
levels.description: Blue inset border shadow for focus/hover states on product images.
